mentions.name: WHILM
mentions.description: A free movie picker that recommends a film based on the user's current mood, asking "How was your day?" instead of what they like, and delivering a suggestion in three taps.
mentions.problem: Picking a movie had become the worst part of daily movie watching: scrolling forever or choosing from what Netflix surfaced, then quitting halfway because the film didn't fit the mood.
mentions.audience: Anyone who watches movies and struggles to pick one
mentions.source_excerpt: WHILM (https://whilm.com/en/) — a movie picker that asks "How was your day?" instead of what you like.
